exposure: Method of induction (prostaglandins vs. foley's catheter and prostaglandins)
outcome: Delivery outcomes (LSCS rate, indications for LSCS)
Reasons for NICU admission (e.g., respiratory distress)
cohort: 300 pregnant women with singleton pregnancies who were planned for induction of labor.
finding: The study found that prostaglandins were the most common method of labor induction, with a 15.67% LSCS rate primarily due to meconium-stained amniotic fluid with fetal distress, and a 13% NICU admission rate mainly for respiratory distress.
mod_finding: LSCS was performed in 15.67% of cases, primarily due to meconium-stained amniotic fluid with fetal distress.
